summary: Eastern International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a notice, proxy statement, and proxy card for an Extraordinary General Meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 22, 2026. The meeting will consider ordinary resolution 1 to re-designate 1,000,000 issued preferred shares as Series A preferred shares and adjust authorized share capital, and special resolution 2 to adopt an amended memorandum and articles of association. This is a routine corporate governance matter involving share class redesignation and charter amendments, not a transformative special situation event. No price, premium, advisor, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. Watch for shareholder vote outcome.
